wvi.title: Attention
wvi.1: We strongly advise against using Wi-Fi in ZigBee operation. Serial communication over Wi-Fi is not robust enough and does not contain any error correction mechanisms to compensate for fluctuating connections or packet loss. The same applies to WAN and VPN connections. See also:
wvi.2: When used as a Thread Border Router (currently under development), this problem does not occur.

bh.title: Encrypted CZC network — up to 8 Satellites
bh.description: Extend one Zigbee network over an encrypted IP connection. Zigbee software connects to Master; up to eight Satellites provide remote radio coverage. Use the same PSK on every node.
bh.keyHelp: Use the same PSK on Master and all Satellites. Generate once and copy to the other nodes. An empty field keeps the saved key.
